steps.prompt: You have $1000$ points and spend $370$. How many are left? How did you work it out?
steps.placeholder: Left… I worked it out by…

cards.title: Times 100 and bonds to 1000
cards.body: Times $100$ moves every digit two places left: $37 \times 100 = 3700$. Bonds to $1000$ work like bonds to $100$, one place bigger: $370 + 630 = 1000$.

steps.text: The tens: $7$ tens need $3$ more tens to make a hundred.
That makes a new hundred, so the hundreds make $9$, not $10$: $3 + 6 = 9$.

cards.title: The common trap
cards.body: For $370$, some people answer $730$: they make the hundreds $10$ and the tens $10$. That adds to $1100$. The tens already make a hundred, so the hundreds make $9$.

prompts: How is a bond to $1000$ like a bond to $100$?
